blocks.content: India marked World Elephant Day on 12 August 2026 with official statements on elephant conservation, habitat protection, and human-elephant conflict management. The country has 33 Elephant Reserves across 14 States and 150 scientifically validated elephant corridors. India is home to nearly 60% of the global wild Asian elephant population.

items: World Elephant Day is observed every year on 12 August.
India has 33 Elephant Reserves across 14 States.
India has 150 scientifically validated elephant corridors.
Project Elephant was launched in 1992 as a centrally sponsored scheme.
